text:
nate (PM): Dropping a quick review request for the invite + roles panel update in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newmock. Focus: SSO toggle position, dense roles view, and faster audit access (we're calling it Audit Finder). Any blockers? :eyes:

rina (Designer): Pushed a dense layout (5 rows) and a right-aligned micro-kebab. Concern: removing visible action labels might confuse some users.

lee (Frontend): Hover-only actions cause reflow on Safari. Prefer always-visible micro-kebab with low opacity. Also need 44px touch targets when on mobile.

vince (Eng-ML): Accessibility: hover-only breaks keyboard/SR. Micro-kebab must be focusable with aria-label like "row actions for <user/org>". Role chips should announce state e.g. "Role: Billing Admin, assigned".

tessa (Support): From tickets: customers get lost when audit is two clicks deep. Recommend a top-right Audit icon that opens Audit Finder + an optional timestamp link in rows.

rina (Designer): I can add a subtle link icon next to timestamps to anchor Audit Finder. Will try both global icon + inline anchors in the mock.

a11y-bot: Quick checklist: 1) micro-kebab = keyboard focusable + aria-expanded. 2) roles table = semantic table or role-list with headings. 3) Audit Finder modal needs aria-modal, labelledby, and focus trap. 4) ensure skip links for long org lists.

lee (Frontend): Implementation plan: route param for anchor (/orgs/:id/audit?anchor=evt_123), fallback tooltip if audit not enabled. Will prototype and test Safari.

vince (Eng-ML): Please expose visible focus ring on compressed rows; current frames remove outlines. That will be a blocker for keyboard users.

nate (PM): Copy tweaks: change "Invite team" -> "Invite people" and SSO label to "Enforce SSO sign-in" with short helper text beneath. Agree?

rina (Designer): Agree on "Invite people". For SSO label I'll show short label + helper copy below to avoid breaking header layout.

lee (Frontend): We'll use aria-describedby for the helper copy so SRs get full context.

tessa (Support): I'll draft KB for the new label and Audit Finder flows.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run axe/VO checks before merging and include aria attributes in the PR description.

nate (PM): Thanks all 8522; devs and design to post updates here by Thu.
